title: Breadth-First Search on Graph Quiz
description: A quick check to review BFS on graphs.

questions.questionText: Which data structure does BFS use?
questions.explanation: BFS uses a queue to process nodes in the order they are discovered.

questions.questionText: Why does BFS need a visited set?

options.text: To avoid visiting the same node repeatedly
To convert all nodes to strings

questions.explanation: Graphs may contain cycles, so a visited set prevents repeated visits and infinite loops.
